checks.description: Game routes preserve detail, position and return destinations without inventing games.
Library and focused review are separate; Back restores search, one board, no analysis on navigation.
Opening patterns are bounded and expandable; all remain reachable outside game detail.
Attack/defence tags require legal stored engine evidence; neutral moves and incomplete proof stay unlabelled.
Mate distances use learner moves, both colours, selectable limits 1–4, exclude mate 17 and keep valid alternatives.
Tactical filters and mate limit persist, retain hidden answers and distinguish missing evidence from no errors.
Real Stockfish labelled sound-move and tactical cases retain correct filters; fake engines cannot satisfy this gate.
Recurring objective patterns use distinct game evidence, bounded selection and transparent ranking; sparse evidence stays provisional.
Profiles, time-control/analysis cohorts, recency and repetitions remain separate; selecting a focus creates no analysis or credit.
The learner sees a supported focus, reason, source games and a direct practice action with no extra board or forced cloud service.

manual: Learner understands the recommendation without explanation from the developer
Delayed recall, unfamiliar-position transfer and fewer serious errors in later games
